items.title: Impeccable 4.0
items.context: A design-control system for moving beyond generic defaults.

items.title: The problem is sameness
items.context: Taste has to enter the workflow before the first composition becomes the default.

items.title: Live Mode changes the interaction
items.context: Visual direction becomes something you inspect and choose—not merely describe.

items.title: Worlds supply a complete visual grammar
items.context: A world constrains composition, typography, material, rhythm, and interaction together.

items.title: Options respond to the project
items.context: The system proposes directions grounded in the current surface instead of a generic style menu.

items.title: One skill exposes a design workflow
items.context: Commands separate shaping, detection, refinement, documentation, and finish review.

items.title: Anti-patterns become detectable
items.context: Recurring machine-made defaults can be named, located, and removed deliberately.

items.title: Installation is deliberately lightweight
items.context: The design system enters the existing workflow through one package command.

items.title: The example begins with purpose
items.context: The demonstration starts from the site's reason to exist before choosing its appearance.

items.title: Compare directions before committing
items.context: Multiple treatments expose range and make the design decision visual.

items.title: The first result is a baseline
items.context: A complete first pass creates something concrete to inspect—not an excuse to stop iterating.

items.title: Live comparison creates a selection loop
items.context: Side-by-side alternatives make differences in hierarchy and character immediately visible.

items.title: The next pass deliberately increases range
items.context: The workflow pushes beyond cautious polish to test a materially stronger direction.

items.title: Detection turns taste into action
items.context: The working design is checked against explicit visual anti-patterns.

items.title: The chosen world becomes a design record
items.context: Documented decisions keep later iterations coherent instead of rediscovering taste each time.

items.title: Outside references add specificity
items.context: Real visual references communicate proportion and texture that prose cannot fully encode.

items.title: Reference becomes interpretation—not imitation
items.context: The final pass translates the reference grammar into a distinct working result.
